developments.name: Aria Reserve
developments.summary: Two glass towers beside gardens and a bayfront promenade on Biscayne Bay. Erik is part of the sales team.
publishedFacts: Developer: Melo Group. Architecture: Arquitectonica. Interiors: MORADA Haute Design. Landscape: ARQ GEO.
Lobby services described in the brochure: valet, 24-hour front desk and concierge.
Bay Level is a building amenity level: waterfront walk, kayak and paddleboard dock, restaurant and café, lounge pool, sun deck, whirlpool spa, meditation garden, observatory and dog park.
Skylobby is a building amenity level: business center, meeting rooms, flexible offices, coworking, coffee station, adult lounge with a bayfront terrace, private elevator and foyer, and wine storage.

Garden Level is a building amenity level: semi-Olympic pool, whirlpool, splash pad, playground, mini golf, theater, party room with kitchen and terrace, BBQ areas, children’s and teens’ rooms, and a wine lounge.
Fitness and spa, also building amenities: gym with an outdoor exercise area, tennis, padel and basketball courts, yoga lounge, meditation garden, massage rooms, sauna and steam room.
Brochure floor ranges: panoramic residences floors 3–56, Skyview Villas floors 47–56, penthouses floors 57–59, Penthouse Mansions floors 60–62.

Conflict: the homepage says 1–4 bedrooms according to Erik’s site, while the project brochure describes residences of one to five bedrooms from 1,028 to over 3,000 sq ft. Say that the two published sources differ and that sizes vary by residence.
The brochure contains historical pricing and delivery references. Do not state them as current terms.

developments.name: ORA by Casa Tua
developments.summary: Casa Tua’s residential concept in Brickell, combining nature, design and shared spaces. The official site describes residences designed by m2atelier. No individual residence is published on this website.

developments.name: Baccarat Residences
developments.summary: A branded residential concept where the Miami River meets Biscayne Bay. The project site presents architecture by Arquitectonica and interiors by Meyer Davis, curated by Baccarat. No individual residence is published on this website.

developments.name: Okan Tower
developments.summary: A mixed-use tower with a curved glass silhouette in Downtown Miami, combining residences and hospitality. No individual residence is published on this website.

developments.name: Brickell Flatiron
developments.summary: A 64-story residential tower in Miami’s financial district, completed in 2019, with 527 residences. Luis Revuelta designed the curved façade and elliptical terraces. Massimo Iosa Ghini led the interior architecture. Developer: CMC Group.
developments.buildingAmenities: The project page describes building amenities, including a 64th-floor rooftop with a panoramic pool, cabanas, daybeds and views of Biscayne Bay and the skyline. Those are amenities of the building, not features of an individual residence.

residences.name: Aria Reserve 3002 A
facts: North Tower, floor 30, line 02A Special.
3 bedrooms plus an office, 3½ bathrooms.
Air-conditioned interior 2,390 sq ft · 222 m². Terrace 334 sq ft · 31 m². Total area 2,724 sq ft · 253 m².
The listing describes a double-width living and dining room with floor-to-ceiling windows and direct Biscayne Bay views.
Conflict: one passage says the living and dining room is 26 × 30 ft, and another says the 02A social space is approximately 26 × 31 ft. Quote both published figures and do not choose one.
The listing says the 02A Special collection comprises 29 residences. Do not turn that into a claim that only a few remain.
Appliances are described as included according to the listing.
The page describes a purchase by contract assignment and says the deposit breakdown must be confirmed with Erik. Do not invent the assignment amount or the balance due.
Delivery and availability statements on the source are inconsistent. Do not state a delivery date.

Published prices conflict and must both be named: the listing card and the sale-price line show US$2,950,000, and another line on the same residence page labels US$3,290,000 as a historical asking price. Identify each label and refer the visitor to Erik to confirm which figure is current and whether the residence is available.

residences.name: Brickell Flatiron PH5503
facts: Address published on the residence page: 1000 Brickell Plaza, Miami, FL 33131.
Floor 55. 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms and 1 half bathroom.
Listed interior area 2,076 sq ft. 2 assigned parking spaces.
Published list price: US$2,800,000.

Published monthly HOA fee: US$3,165.58. The page says it includes operations, building insurance and reserves, water, sewer, trash, internet and cable, pool towel service and valet. Electricity is billed separately.
Published tax assessed value: US$2,283,876 (2025). This is an assessed value, not the asking price.
Listed terms on the page: cash, conventional or FHA. Sale condition: as-is.
The terrace and the city and bay views are described as features of this residence. The rooftop pool is on the 64th floor and is a building amenity, not a private feature of PH5503.
